# The Copperline Eatery

> Family-owned breakfast and lunch restaurant in Chicopee, Massachusetts, open since 1993. Voted Best Breakfast in Western Massachusetts by MassLive readers and Best French Toast in Western Massachusetts by WWLP 22News. Also a full-service caterer for Western Massachusetts.

## Key facts

- Address: 409 Broadway, Chicopee, MA 01020 (Hampden County, Pioneer Valley)
- Phone: (413) 594-8332
- Email: copperlineeatery@yahoo.com
- Hours: Mon-Fri 6:00am-2:00pm, Sat 6:00am-1:30pm, Sun 6:30am-1:00pm (open 7 days)
- Rating: 4.5 stars on Google (1,100+ reviews)
- Seating: first-come, first-serve; call ahead for groups of 8+
- Takeout: call (413) 594-8332, ready in 15-20 minutes. Delivery via DoorDash.
- Known for: eggs benedict with house-made hollandaise, homemade corned beef hash, banana bread French toast, the Copperline Special
- Payment: cash and all major credit cards

## Catering

- Serves: Chicopee, Springfield, Holyoke, West Springfield, Agawam, Westfield, Ludlow, South Hadley, Granby, Longmeadow, East Longmeadow, Wilbraham, Hampden, Palmer, Easthampton, Northampton, Belchertown, Amherst, and all of Western Massachusetts
- Pricing: Buffet Packages $13.95-$15.95 per person; Hot Item Buffet from $15.95 per person (40-person minimum); Choice Buffet #1 $14.95, Choice Buffet #2 $17.95, Italian Buffet $17.95 per person. Plus 7% MA meal tax and 15% service fee.
- Service styles: on-site, drop-off, or pick-up; buffet, to-go buffet, or individual portions
- Events: corporate meetings, weddings, showers, graduations, birthdays, holiday parties, church socials, school functions, fundraisers, memorial services
- Booking: 1-2 weeks ahead for most events; 3-4 weeks for large events and Hot Item Buffets
